More Than An Event

We don't simply organise events.
We curate experiences.

Analikha Events brings together celebration, culture, creativity and exceptional talent to create experiences that feel personal, refined and memorable.

The Founder

Deepesha S G

Analikha Events is envisioned as a platform where celebrations meet creativity, culture and meaningful human connection.

Founded and curated by Deepesha S G, the brand focuses on bringing together skilled artists, performers and event professionals to create bespoke experiences for clients.

“Every celebration has a story. Our role is to curate the moments that make it unforgettable.”

Our Philosophy

Purpose behind every experience

Vision

Redefining Event Curation

To redefine event curation by seamlessly integrating luxury experiences, artistic talent and community-driven social initiatives.

Mission

Connecting Talent & Impact

To connect exceptional talent — from makeup artists and choreographers to DJs and magicians — with clients while driving grassroots social change and cultural empowerment through our NGO wing.

Beyond Celebrations

Events with a larger purpose.

Analikha Events aims to bring social impact into the broader event ecosystem through a dedicated NGO initiative focused on community welfare, artistic empowerment and social development.

The goal is to create opportunities where creativity, culture and community development can reinforce one another.
